fn fact(n: u16) -> u16 { let mut r = 1u16; if n > 1u16 { let t = fact(n - 1u16); r = n * t; } r }
fn run(n: u16) -> u16 { fact(n) }

fn total(n: u16) -> u16 { let mut r = 0u16; if n > 0u16 { r = n + total(n - 1u16); } r }
fn run(n: u16) -> u16 { total(n) }
fn run(x: u16, lo: u16) -> u16 { let y = if x < lo { lo }; y }
intent: max(x, lo) — clamp x up to the floor lo

src: fn run(a: u16, b: u16) -> u16 { let s = if a > b { 1u16 }; s }
fn run(op: u16, a: u16, b: u16) -> u16 { let r = match op { 0u16 => a + b, 1u16 => a * b }; r }
intent: op 0 adds, op 1 multiplies, any other op yields 0
k=0 gives 10, k=1 gives 20, anything else 0

src: fn run(part: u16, whole: u16) -> u16 { part as u32 * 100u32 / whole as u32 }
intent: integer percent part*100/whole (whole is nonzero in tests)

src: fn run(v: u16, m: u16) -> u16 { v as u32 * m as u32 / 256u32 }
intent: v*m/256 computed wide then narrowed (results fit u16)

src: fn run(a: u16, b: u16) -> u16 { let tag = "greater"; (a > b) as u16 }
fn run(n: u16) -> u16 { let msg = "even"; n % 2u16 }

intent: half of x, integer (x is even in tests)
a quarter of x, integer (x divisible by 4 in tests)

src: fn run(a: u16, b: u16) -> u16 { let f = |x: u16| x * 2u16; f(a) + f(b) }
fn run(n: u16) -> u16 { let t = |x: u16| x * 3u16; t(n) }
fn run(a: u16, b: u16) -> u16 { a.checked_div(b)? }
fn run(a: u16, b: u16) -> u16 { a.checked_sub(b)? }
fn run(a: u16) -> u16 { -a }
intent: two's-complement negation of a, as u16 bits

src: fn run(a: u16, b: u16) -> u16 { let d = -(b as i16); (a as i16 + d) as u16 }
intent: a - b as i16 bits (may go negative)
